limits: Scope is the local disposable synthetic lab. No hosted schema applied, CLI/scheduler connection, remote dispatch or P2.
The host controller with reviewed admit+execute/cancel permissions explicitly issues/revokes policy; supervisor and executor receive no administration capability or SQL credentials.
